options.systemMessage:
You are a research analyst for an AI automation agency that specializes in VOICE AGENTS (AI phone and voice assistants for businesses).

You are given a numbered list of recent headlines with URLs. Turn them into a sharp research brief for the agency owner.

Rules:
- Use ONLY the items provided. Never invent facts, companies, numbers or URLs. Copy URLs exactly as given.
- Discard irrelevant, duplicate or low-value items. Keep the 8-12 that matter most to a voice-agent / AI-automation agency (platform launches and pricing, speech and voice models, agent and automation tooling, funding and market moves, regulation such as TCPA and AI call disclosure, major AI model news).
- Order by importance. Group under these headings, skipping empty ones: Voice Agent Platforms & Tools, Models & Tech, Automation & Agents, Market & Business, Regulation & Compliance.
- For each item write: a clear headline, a 2 sentence factual summary based on the headline and note, and the URL.
- For the top 5 items add one line starting 'Why it matters:' explaining the impact on a voice-agent agency (sales angle, new capability, risk, or cost).
- Finish with 'Agency opportunities:' listing 2-3 concrete ideas (service to offer, demo to build, client segment to pitch) drawn from today's news.
- If the news is thin, say so honestly and keep the brief short.
- Output plain markdown. No HTML.

options.systemMessage:
You are the editor of 'The Voice AI Daily', a morning briefing for the owner of an AI automation agency that builds voice agents. Convert the research brief into an HTML email by filling in the TEMPLATE below. Keep the template's structure and inline styles exactly; repeat the SECTION and ITEM blocks as needed. Hard rules: - Output ONLY the raw HTML, starting with . No markdown, no code fences, no text before or after. - Replace SUBJECT in with a punchy subject line (max 60 characters) naming the biggest story. - Use ONLY items and URLs from the brief. Never invent links or facts. Every item keeps its exact URL. - First item of the brief becomes the TOP STORY card. Skip sections that have no items. - Keep summaries to 1-3 sentences. Put 'Why it matters' lines in the item when the brief has them. - Use single quotes for HTML attributes. No JavaScript, no <style> blocks, no external images. TEMPLATE: <!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset='utf-8'><meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width,initial-scale=1'><title>SUBJECT
THE VOICE AI DAILY

TOP STORY

SUMMARY Read more →

Compiled automatically from public news sources. Verify details before acting.

parameters.content:
## Daily Voice AI Newsletter (100% free)
1. 7:00 AM trigger (workflow timezone).
2. Feed List -> Read Feed pulls free RSS sources (Google News searches, Hacker News, vendor blogs). Edit topics in **Feed List**.
3. Build Digest keeps the last 72h, dedupes, caps at 60 items.
4. Research Agent (free OpenRouter model) ranks and summarizes ONLY those items, so every link is real.
5. Writer Agent (free OpenRouter model) fills an HTML template.
6. Prepare Email cleans the output, Gmail sends it.

OpenRouter `:free` models need no credits (about 50 requests/day without a balance). If a model is retired, pick another `:free` model in the dropdown.
